route._layer_rules_removed: REMOVED 8 Sep 2026 17:50: the per-class layer rule (rule 2) cost C8 three routes that never finished a pass (12 min, 90 min, 3 h with nothing written) while the same DSN without it auto-routed in 14 min 21 s; and the D9 read-back this morning showed the router does not hold a class to its layers anyway. The pair pre-router lays the pairs on their layers by construction, which is what enforces the intent now.
route._ceiling_measured: 9 September 2026 19:05 CEST: this is the PROBE, not the release route. The rule of the record is that a pass ceiling comes from a measured 3-pass probe of THIS DSN, never from an ambition, and this DSN is not B18's: the I/O high-availability layer added 169 parts and 40 nets. Read the 3-pass rate off this run, then set the release ceiling from it in b19-release.json.

notes: B19 (9 September 2026, MESHSAT-862, appendix 32.86): the first B phase with the I/O high-availability layer. The board builds and check_pcb_b.py prints ALL PASS on it; this profile measures how the new DSN routes. B18 is superseded and no release is cut against it.
